about: The Rebbeim's pictures on their cards (the towns, the ohalim, 770; owner, Nov 6 2026: next to each name, in a proper gilded frame): web/img/rebbeim/<key>.jpg at 300x375, made by scripts/head-photos/rebbeim-portraits.py from the source kept in work/head-photos/rebbeim/<key>.jpg ('box' is the crop in that source's pixels; 'fill', rare, an area painted over with the backdrop first; 'fit', a sefer's title page shown whole on white). The Alter Rebbe's and the Tzemach Tzedek's are the traditional portraits, not photographs; the Rebbe Rashab's, the Frierdiker Rebbe's and the Rebbe's are photographs. No picture of the Mitteler Rebbe is known, and the portrait attributed to the Rebbe Maharash (printed in HaMivaser, 14 Kislev 5773) is probably not him (owner, Nov 6: 'cancel the maharash'): for these two, the title page of a sefer of theirs, as Chabadpedia does (owner: 'Do how chabadpedia does it with like the sefer shaar blatt'). Those two came from a Firecrawl screenshot of Chabadpedia's file page (chabadpedia.co.il refuses our downloads), the page's preview cut out of it.
